title: Aragen Launches High-Potency CRDMO Platform in Hyderabad for Oncology Molecules

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: Aragen Life Sciences has commenced operations at Aragen OneHP, a high-potency development and manufacturing platform at its Nacharam campus in Hyderabad, adding capabilities for highly potent molecules, including cytotoxic compounds used in oncology.

The approximately 15,000 sq ft platform is designed to provide customers with an integrated pathway from milligram-scale discovery through process development, scale-up and multi-kilogram current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) manufacturing.

Aragen OneHP operates one manufacturing line with a designed capacity of 500 to 600 kg of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) annually. The platform can support highly potent compounds, including cytotoxic molecules and targeted oncology therapies, and is also intended to provide a foundation for future expansion into advanced modalities.

The platform includes small-scale chemistry synthesis of up to 10 g, non-GMP process development and scale-up of up to 500 g, and cGMP manufacturing from 500 g to 5 kg per batch.

Advanced containment systems at the facility are designed to handle compounds with occupational exposure limits of up to 10 ng/m³, subject to ongoing validation.

According to Aragen, OneHP will enable programmes to progress from development through clinical and commercial supply through an integrated platform, reducing the need for handoffs between different service providers.

"With OneHP, we are bringing discovery, development and cGMP manufacturing for highly potent molecules onto a more integrated platform. This can reduce handoffs between providers, while keeping process knowledge and programme context connected as a molecule moves from early development towards commercial supply," said Aniel Khubchandani, Chief Executive Officer – Small Molecules-CDMO, Aragen Life Sciences.

Highly potent molecules, including cytotoxic compounds, require specialised handling, containment and manufacturing infrastructure. The new platform brings together small-scale chemistry synthesis, process development, scale-up and cGMP manufacturing capabilities for such molecules.

Aragen said OneHP also lays the foundation for future expansion into advanced modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and peptide-drug conjugates.

The new platform is part of Aragen's ongoing capacity expansion programme. The company invested more than Rs 1,000 crore in capital expenditure over the three years ended March 2026 to build capabilities across small molecules and biologics.

Aragen's contract development and manufacturing business grew at a compound annual growth rate of 19% during the period, while its contract research business grew at 12%.

As of March 31, 2026, the company's installed small-molecule capacity stood at 364 KL across its Hyderabad and Visakhapatnam facilities. Nearly 95% of Aragen's revenue in the year ended March 2026 came from global customers, while the company served 591 customers globally, including 16 of the world's Top 20 pharmaceutical companies.

Aragen's Hyderabad manufacturing and analytical operations are accredited by the USFDA, EDQM, PMDA, MFDS, ANVISA, WHO Geneva and CDSCO.

Aragen Life Sciences is a contract research, development and manufacturing organization serving global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, animal health and agrochemical companies. Its capabilities span drug discovery, pre-clinical research, development and manufacturing for small molecules and biologics.
